description: Set/raise a metered-per-period subscriber's budget (new_cap_usdc). Mints the manage token behind the scenes. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required true: raises what may be charged per period.

new_cap_usdc.description: New per-period budget in USDC, e.g. '0.50'. Can only be set or raised.
